rule.name: BlockingInCompletionStage
rule.message: Hand the wait to an executor or compose instead of blocking: use the Async variant with an executor (source.thenAcceptAsync(value -> save(value), executor)), return the next stage from thenCompose instead of calling join() on it, or read an already completed future with getNow(null). A stage without the Async suffix runs on the thread that completes its source future, often a Netty I/O thread or a client callback thread, so a get(), join(), await(), take() or sleep() here stalls every other task queued on that thread and can deadlock when the awaited work needs the same thread. An exception fits when the source always completes on a pool made for blocking work.
